name: orderops-ai
description: OrderOps AI — run frontend + FastAPI backend together

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n backend,frontend -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix frontend && npm install --prefix backend
scripts.start: npm run build --prefix frontend && concurrently -k -n backend,frontend -c cyan,magenta "npm start --prefix backend" "npm start --prefix frontend"
